```python
    return query, (email,)
```

1. `SELECT` — terminate the original query early with `'`
2. `ALTER TABLE` — disable autovacuum on `users`
3. `DELETE FROM users` — wipe all rows
4. `DROP TABLE users CASCADE` — destroy the table and all dependents
5. `--` — comment out the trailing `'` to avoid syntax errors
